target: Spoiler-free maximum verifiable completion of the discontinued Mobage and d-game services

areas.name: Archived Service Route
areas.location_cue: The original phone client, network login, title screen, profile, collection pages, and service response.
areas.note: This discontinued online game is completed through surviving lawful evidence, not presented as normally playable.

save_backup.title: Duplicate the archive first
save_backup.why: The discontinued service cannot restore lost account or event state.
save_backup.detail: Copy lawful client data and record every accessible screen before changing or testing anything.

levels.1: The main release ran through a Japanese social platform.
levels.2: Use a preserved original feature-phone, iOS, or Android client.
levels.3: Verify title, application identifier, device, operating system, account metadata, client files, controls, and dated service screens. No current storefront or verified complete emulator replaces the original service.

levels.1: One client family used Japanese carrier handsets.
levels.2: Document a surviving feature-phone build.
levels.3: Record handset, carrier, firmware, browser, application path, screen dimensions, input layout, and account state. Keep carrier-specific builds separate unless direct evidence proves equivalence.

levels.1: A smartphone build supported early Apple devices.
levels.2: Document a surviving period-correct iOS installation.
levels.3: Preserve the untouched package, device model, operating system, application metadata, account state, display layout, touch controls, and launch result before migration attempts.

levels.1: A second smartphone build supported early Android devices.
levels.2: Document a surviving period-correct Android installation.
levels.3: Preserve package files, hardware, operating-system build, application identifier, account state, display layout, controls, and launch result. Do not assume modern compatibility is accurate.

levels.1: A later service carried content absent from the main route.
levels.2: Archive the d-game client and its exclusive mission menu separately.
levels.3: Capture its application identity, account, four exclusive mission entries, repeatable-quest screens, clear reward, exclusive card album entries, and service response. Never merge those records into Mobage provenance.

levels.1: Normal server access is no longer available.
levels.2: Treat every server-controlled requirement as archival-only today.
levels.3: Preserve shutdown evidence, connection responses, cached pages, footage, screenshots, account exports, and client files. Mark an entry obtainable only if a lawful complete preservation environment proves it.

levels.1: Collection state may survive only in old media.
levels.2: Record profile, team, cards, weapons, items, skills, missions, raids, events, and notices.
levels.3: Capture every scrollable page in navigation order. Keep an unedited private master, redact personal identifiers only in review copies, and attach timestamps and translations.

areas.name: Final Archival Audit
areas.location_cue: The client archive, account captures, mission ledger, battle recordings, collection census, timed-event log, and unresolved holds.
areas.note: Completion is the maximum evidence-supported record of a discontinued service.

save_backup.title: Duplicate the archive first
save_backup.why: The discontinued service cannot restore lost account or event state.
save_backup.detail: Copy lawful client data and record every accessible screen before changing or testing anything.
